# Tanseki is read-only

**Pull requests to this repository are not merged.** That includes bug fixes,
typos, and one-line changes. This is a maintainer capacity decision and not a
review of your work.

You do not need permission to change Tanseki. It is licensed under
[Apache-2.0](../LICENSE), so you may fork it and publish your fork under any
terms you choose, including proprietary ones, and you keep copyright in it.

## What to do instead

- **Need the change in Tanseki?** Fork it and make the change there. That is the
  supported path, not a fallback.
- **Want it upstream eventually?** Email or send the patch to the maintainer
  directly. Say what problem it solves and which fork or branch it lives in.
- **Worth telling us regardless?** Open an issue describing the problem. A
  clear report with a reproducing command is valuable even when the fix will
  not come from us.
- **Found a vulnerability?** Do not open a public pull request or issue. See
  [SECURITY.md](../SECURITY.md).

## If you send one anyway

This template exists so you learn the policy before writing a patch, not to be
used as a checklist. Your pull request will be closed without review.

## Before you close it

Check that the change contains no secrets, private data, local vault state,
generated build output, or unrelated cleanup. See
[CONTRIBUTING.md](../CONTRIBUTING.md) for the architecture rules and the local
verification path, both of which apply to a fork as much as to upstream.
